docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,967.50 FILED BY CLAUDIUS DEREK AS TO DEFENDANT MAJORS JANET ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-25-1994 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 08
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL
CERTIFIED LETTER TO JANET MAJORS RETURNED SIGNED.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CLAUDIUS DEREK RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT MAJORS JANET $2,567.50 PRINCIPAL, $15.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,582.50, PAYABLE IN 3 MONTHLY INSTALLMENTS STARTING 4/30/94 & MONTHLY THEREAFTER. EXECUTION STAYED SO LONG AS STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT AS TO DEFENDANT MAJORS JANET
